displayName: 背手负鼠中文抽象台词包
description: A sidecar Chinese meme speech pack for Window Possum. It is designed for future Codex Pet speech hooks, forks, or overlay integrations.

compatibility.codexPetManifest: The current official Codex custom pet manifest only requires visual assets. Keep this file outside window-possum/pet.json so the pet remains installable.
